source.text: It appears that #Ferguson PD are trying to assassinate Mike Brown's character after literally assassinating Mike Brown.

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet accusing Ferguson PD of assassinating Mike Brown character after killing him; excluded source-authored follow-ups, quote-only reposts, jokes, off-topic replies, and ambiguous calls for more information; balanced 15 support and 15 oppose.
note: support = agrees that Ferguson PD released irrelevant/selective information to smear Brown, taint the jury pool, or deflect from the shooting; oppose = argues the information was requested/relevant, that police could not yet release shooting details, or that people should wait for facts before calling it character assassination or execution.
